articles.title: Global Market: Japan stocks slide as stronger Yen hits exporters; Nikkei drops Over 2%
articles.content: Japanese stocks tumbled as a sharp rally in the yen weighed on export-oriented companies, with the Nikkei falling over 2%. Auto and chip stocks led the declines, although SoftBank, Lasertec and Kioxia outperformed. Investors are now watching for further currency intervention and its impact on corporate earnings and market sentiment.

articles.title: Zee shares tumble 12% after Sebi action against Subhash Chandra, Punit Goenka
articles.content: Zee Entertainment shares plunged over 12% after Sebi barred founder Subhash Chandra and CEO Punit Goenka from the securities market for one year over an unauthorised property pledge case. The regulator also fined ZEEL and flagged governance lapses, even as shareholders recently approved a Rs 3,144 crore promoter fundraise.

articles.title: GAIL India shares tumble 5% despite Q1 net profit doubling to Rs 4,665 crore. Buy, sell or hold?
articles.content: GAIL India shares fell 5% despite the Maharatna PSU reporting a near doubling of Q1 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 4,665 crore. articles.title: Rupee climbs to one-month peak of 95.13 vs USD on oil slump, stronger inflows
articles.content: The Indian rupee reached a one-month high as oil prices declined and foreign inflows increased.  The Reserve Bank of India is expected to maintain current interest rates this week. Foreign investors returned to Indian stocks, and bond yields saw a slight increase.

articles.title: HFCL shares rebound 5% on Rs 523 crore order win. Still time to buy after 195% rally in 6 months?

articles.title: Global Market: China's central bank vows timely policy adjustments, backs panda bond market
articles.content: China's central bank has pledged to adjust its monetary policy tools in a timely manner while maintaining an appropriately loose policy stance to support the economy. articles.title: Maruti Suzuki shares decline over 2% after Q1. Morgan Stanley, Motilal Oswal decode the road ahead
articles.content: Maruti Suzuki shares fell over 2% after the automaker reported an 11% YoY decline in June-quarter standalone net profit, even as revenue rose 36% and sales volumes hit a record high. articles.title: Global Market: Japan, US confirm coordinated yen intervention to stem currency slide
articles.content: Japan's finance ministry confirmed that Tokyo and Washington jointly intervened in currency markets to support the yen for the first time since 2011. The coordinated move underscores both governments' resolve to curb excessive currency volatility, though analysts remain cautious about its long-term impact.

articles.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex surges 650 points, Nifty tops 24,600. 6 key factors fueling the rally
articles.content: Indian stock markets saw significant gains on Monday, with the Sensex and Nifty rising approximately one percent. Sectors such as FMCG and Metal also demonstrated strong performance, reflecting positive investor sentiment.

articles.title: ITC shares gain 3% after Q1 results. Here’s why Nomura upgraded the stock to Buy
articles.content: ITC shares rose 2% after the FMCG major reported June-quarter results, despite a 27% YoY decline in standalone net profit. articles.title: India’s IPO boom cools as weak markets force issuers to cut back
articles.content: India's primary market is experiencing a slowdown in 2026, with IPO fundraising down 20% year-on-year to $5.78 billion. Facing market volatility, cautious institutional investors, and moderate post-listing gains, major firms are reducing issue sizes, accepting lower valuations, or putting public listing plans on hold.
